title: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Widow of Urza and ruler of Penregon who discovers she can channel fire, leads an exodus west, and leaves for the western lands after reuniting hope with her grandson.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's former assistant who builds Penregon's civils, then sets fire to his factory and office and vanishes.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: Kayla's grandson, Harbin's son, who has magic and leaves to join a school of magic and artifice on Ronom Lake.

entities.name: Myrel
entities.description: Penregon's scout captain, who reports on the factory fire and later leads the scouts west.

entities.name: Raddic of Kroog
entities.description: The Talite crusader leader, later reported dead after the Iron Tower and Mishra's forge.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Kayla's son, a pilot who died in the war; rumors say he became a legend of the western sky.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The artificer whose war machines Tawnos's civils were based on.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, whose war machines also used powerstones.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: An artificer thought to run a school of magic and artifice with a mage called Duck; Tawnos thinks of her before disappearing.

entities.name: Duck
entities.description: A mage said to run a school of magic and artifice with Nod; Kayla suspects he is Tawnos.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: A scholar of Lat-Nam and leader of the Third Path whose meditative techniques Kayla studies.

entities.name: Fask
entities.description: A clever brute and the warlord who rules Kroog; he is haunted by an oracle's curse and sees a spirit in his chamber.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who travels back in time as a spirit, is seen by Fask, and asks to be pulled out because the Temporal Anchor is miscalibrated.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who monitors and pulls Teferi out of the past.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: An artificer who has thoughts on the time-travel attempt.

entities.name: Tal
entities.description: A god of Yotia worshipped by the Talite crusaders.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: The coastal city that Kayla rules and eventually abandons as the ice age approaches.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Kayla's old home, now a flooded lake city ruled by Warlord Fask.

entities.name: New Yotia
entities.description: The first city of the green west, a wooden river city on a mesa above the Mardun where Kayla settles for a time.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: The continent devastated by the cataclysm and slowly freezing.

entities.name: Kher Ridges
entities.description: The mountain range that separates Penregon and the east from the green west.

entities.name: Mardun
entities.description: A river flowing from the Khers past New Yotia and the ruins of Kroog.

entities.name: Talites
entities.description: Crusaders of the Church of Tal who attack Penregon, later return and serve as mercenaries in the west.

entities.name: Third Path
entities.description: An esoteric order of mages based at Terisia City whose writings reach Penregon.

entities.name: Civils
entities.description: Tawnos's automatons, adapted back into war machines for the siege.

entities.name: Powerstones
entities.description: Thran stones that power the civils and the war machines.

entities.name: Temporal Anchor
entities.description: The device used to send Teferi's spirit into the past, which is not calibrated correctly.

entities.name: Siege of Penregon
entities.description: A single-day assault on Penregon by Talite crusaders combined with an uprising by hidden cultists inside the city.

entities.name: Cataclysm
entities.description: The blast that ended the brothers' war and began the ice age.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: The long winter that overtakes Terisiare and Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which the story takes place.

events.summary: In his factory, Tawnos realizes his civils were built from Urza's war machines and that Penregon's powerstones will run out, making war inevitable.
events.quote: Tawnos realized that Penregon's stockpile would dry out in the coming years.

events.summary: Tawnos tears pages of his toy designs from his own notebook and sets fire to his office.
events.quote: No one on the factory floor saw the fire until it was too late.

events.summary: Talite crusaders fail to take Penregon from outside while hidden cultists inside set the city ablaze; the defenders drive both back.
events.quote: Alley by alley, street by street, Penregon's civils and militia drove the Talites back to their safehouses.

events.summary: Kayla spends the siege in a command post with Jarsyl, deciding what to do with captured Talites.
events.quote: Kayla had spent the brutal day in a well-defended post with the commanders of the city guard and militia.

events.summary: Kayla and Myrel survey the burned factory and conclude that Tawnos set the fire himself and vanished.
events.quote: Tawnos did this,

events.summary: Ten years later, silent summers, the frozen harbor and a stream of settlers westward mark Penregon's decline.
events.quote: Penregon's harbor suffered its first solid freeze.

events.summary: Scouts report green lands in the west, and Kayla proclaims that Penregon's salvation lies there; thousands set out in caravans.
events.quote: proclaimed to the people of Penregon that their salvation lay in the distant west.

events.summary: Scouts return from the north with news of glaciers and a frozen ocean, saying the world is ending.
events.quote: the scouts told Kayla that the world was ending.

events.summary: Alone in her manor on a winter night, Kayla screams her grief until fire bursts from her hands, her first magic.
events.quote: Fire coursed up from some deep knot in her gut

events.summary: Kayla studies Hurkyl's writings and learns to control her magic through a stone from Kroog.
events.quote: Kayla's new nightly practice followed the precepts of Hurkyl's meditative techniques as laid out in the book.

events.summary: Kayla orders the guildmasters and grain-lords to provision the migration and sends Myrel and the scouts west.
events.quote: Myrel went with them; Kayla saw them off

events.summary: The Talites return in a blizzard, learn that Raddic died after the Iron Tower and Mishra's forge, and march west.
events.quote: Many of the faithful died, Raddic among them.

events.summary: Kayla hears a story of a flying man in the western sky and leads a final caravan west out of Penregon.
events.quote: She prepared a final caravan of her people and went west with them

events.summary: The caravan crosses the Khers, losing a quarter of its number, and reaches the western lands along the Mardun.
events.quote: losing a quarter of their number to the cold, the dark, and the desperate creatures there.

events.summary: Kayla reaches New Yotia, lingers there, and resolves to cross the continent to learn the truth about Harbin.
events.quote: Kayla resolved to cross the continent to learn the truth.

events.summary: Kayla secretly displays her magic by snuffing and relighting the lamps.
events.quote: As one, the oil lamps Kayla had left burning snuffed out, then reignited.

events.summary: Jarsyl tells Kayla he cannot go with her because he wants to join a school of magic and artifice run by Nod and Duck, and Kayla blesses it.
events.quote: Go north. If there are teachers greater than me, seek them out.

events.summary: Kayla leaves New Yotia on a riverboat down the Mardun toward Kroog with Talite mercenaries aboard.
events.quote: So she did not protest when a detachment of dark-clad soldiers filed onto her riverboat.

events.summary: Fask, the Tyrant of Kroog, rigs his chamber with strings of noisy objects because an oracle's curse haunts him.
events.quote: This was Fask's trap, his system to prove he was not mad but perceptive.

events.summary: Fask sees a half-formed spirit at the foot of his bed and screams.
events.quote: Fask screamed.

events.summary: Teferi, whispering from the shadows, asks Kaya to pull him out because the Temporal Anchor undershot its target.
events.quote: The Temporal Anchor isn't calibrated correctly, Kaya, and I think we undershot our target

events.summary: Many centuries later, an old man tells his grandchildren the story of the tyrant and the ghost during the Ice Age.
events.quote: The Ice Age was upon Dominaria

relations.quote: her grandson, Jarsyl, came to her modest apartment.
Jarsyl looked so much like his father.
Harbin, her son, legend of the western sky.

relations.note: Urza taught Tawnos and shaped him into a master artificer.
relations.quote: All Tawnos knew he owed to Urza's instruction.

relations.note: Fask rules Kroog as a warlord.
relations.quote: the wealth of Warlord Fask, the Tyrant of Kroog.

relations.note: Kayla leads Penregon as its queen.
relations.quote: the Penregon of Lady Kayla, the last Queen of Argive

relations.note: Kaya pulls Teferi back from the past.

relations.quote: I'm sorry ma'am, but we haven't found him
